card.name: Punctuation right after drug product names
card.fires_on: Punctuation (comma, parenthesis, bracket) or a unit right after a full drug product name, such as 'Injection, USP' or 'Oral Suspension'. Also fires on the gap after a book title in web text.

modes.label: After drug name
modes.description: A comma, bracket or parenthesis directly after a named drug product or its form.

modes.description: A digit or unit within a dose strength in a product name.

modes.label: After book title
modes.description: A space or title word after a book or author listing in web text.
